description: Source code for the HMC5883L magnetometer sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: hmc5883l_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to sensor_value format by dividing by a divider and calculating fractional part.

methods.name: hmc5883l_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific magnetometer channel data and converts it to sensor_value.

methods.name: hmc5883l_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches magnetometer sample data via I2C and stores it in driver data.

methods.name: hmc5883l_init
methods.description: Initializes the HMC5883L device, checks chip ID, configures device settings, and sets up interrupts if enabled.
